name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires you to pick the box up again after it falls, but the only clause is a hard ChainResponse that keeps the box in your hands as soon as it falls, so you can never drop it and pick it up again. Add a clause for picking up the box when it falls: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) is correct, but the task also requires a way to drop it and pick it up again, so a rule like Response(box_fell, holding_box) and Response(box_fell, not holding_box) is needed.

CHANGES REQUIRED: R1 and R2 correctly capture the task, but they imply that the agent can pick up the box while holding it and then drop it before the step limit, which is impossible in this environment. The task requires that the agent keeps the box in its hands until it reaches the exit, so it needs to pick up the box and then move. Add a clause to require the agent to move after picking up the box: `Response(pickup, forward)` hard. Keep the existing clauses, R1 and R2.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: the single clause is the task requirement, and the machine rewards reaching the exit with the box.

texts: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, box_fell) -> u1
(u1, !box_fell&!holding_box) -> u2
(u1, !box_fell&holding_box) -> u0
(u1, box_fell&!holding_box) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, box_fell, u1) -> -1
(u1, !box_fell&!holding_box, u2) -> -10
(u1, !box_fell&holding_box, u0) -> 1
(u1, box_fell&!holding_box, u2) -> -10
